title: LLM-Assisted Verification in Dafny
abstract: arXiv:2611.16886v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Formal verification of complex algorithms requires expertise in program specification, invariant construction, mathematical proof, and the management of automated theorem provers. Although large language models (LLMs) can generate program code and proof fragments, reliably developing complete machine-checked verifications remains challenging: it requires an iterative process of constructing and validating specifications and invariants, building proofs, diagnosing solver failures, and optimizing verification performance. This paper presents a systematic ten-step workflow for LLM-assisted verification of scientific algorithms using the Dafny verification system. The workflow integrates algorithm formalization, contract development, empirical invariant validation, proof construction, bottleneck profiling, and resource-driven proof optimization. translated_title: 基于大语言模型辅助的 Dafny 形式化验证
translated_abstract: 复杂算法的形式化验证需要具备程序规约、不变量构造、数学证明以及自动定理证明器管理等方面的专业知识。尽管大语言模型（LLM）能够生成程序代码和证明片段，但要可靠地开发出完整的机器检验验证仍然具有挑战性：这需要一个迭代过程，包括构建与验证规约和不变量、构建证明、诊断求解器失败以及优化验证性能。本文提出了一个使用 Dafny 验证系统对科学算法进行 LLM 辅助验证的系统性十步工作流。该工作流整合了算法形式化、契约开发、经验性不变量验证、证明构建、瓶颈剖析以及资源驱动的证明优化。作者使用 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 5 和 Opus 5.5 模型应用了该工作流，并结合 LLM 驱动……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个利用大语言模型在 Dafny 中进行科学算法形式化验证的系统性十步工作流，涵盖算法形式化、契约开发、不变量验证、证明构建与优化等环节，并借助 Claude Opus 模型加以应用。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic ten-step workflow for LLM-assisted formal verification of scientific algorithms in Dafny, integrating algorithm formalization, contract development, empirical invariant validation, proof construction, and resource-driven optimization.
